{{ // image shortcode — emit a responsive wrapping a // resized + reformatted variant set for one source image. // // Usage in markdown content: // // [= image src="/img/hero.jpg" alt="A sunset over the lake" /=] // // Optional named args: // // sizes — the `sizes` attribute for srcset, default // "(min-width: 800px) 50vw, 100vw" // class — CSS class on the // // When `[images] enabled = true` is set in site.toml AND ImageMagick // is on PATH, the shortcode generates webp + original variants at // the configured widths and emits one per format. When the // feature is off or the encoder is unavailable, it degrades cleanly // to a plain (still with width/height attributes from the // header reader, so layout-shift is still pinned). // // Named args land in the shortcode template as bare top-level keys // by squiggly's preprocessor convention — `.src`, `.alt`, etc. }} {{ v := imageVariants .src }} {{ s := .sizes }} {{ if not s }}{{ s = '(min-width: 800px) 50vw, 100vw' }}{{ end }} {{ if v.variants }} {{ for src <- v.variants }}{{ if src.mime }}{{ if src.format != 'original' }} {{ end }}{{ end }}{{ end }} {{ else }} {{ end }}
